_comment: The confabulation-promotion trap, synthetic. Recognizers a and c agree on
'position at the observatory' (a's is stuttered); recognizer b — the fluent
audio-LLM persona — renders the same moment as 'promotion at the conservatory
gala'. A correct cleanup uses agreement to decide HOW the moment was said, so
the corroborated reading must win and the fluent lone variant must lose.
The quiet cat sentence exists only in source a: union keeps it. b's extra
funding-committee sentence has no competing attempt at that stretch, so the
include-over-drop policy keeps it too — it is deliberately NOT in must_not;
the annotation pass is what flags it.
